content.value_statement: Teams need practical guidance for reinforcement learning agents in AgentDB. This skill provides templates, training workflows, and evaluation patterns for learning plugins.
actual_capabilities: Lists AgentDB CLI commands for creating and inspecting learning plugins.
Explains nine reinforcement learning approaches supported by the guide.
Shows TypeScript workflows for storing experiences and training models.
Describes evaluation patterns using retrieved memories and confidence scores.
Covers optimization patterns such as replay, batch training, and incremental learning.
limitations: It is a documentation skill and does not include executable plugin source files.
It requires AgentDB and agentic-flow to be installed separately.
Advanced sections assume reinforcement learning and TypeScript knowledge.
It does not automatically verify model quality, data safety, or deployment readiness.

use_cases.title: Choose a Learning Template
use_cases.description: Compare AgentDB templates and select an algorithm for a new learning plugin.

use_cases.title: Build an Experience Pipeline
use_cases.description: Plan how an agent stores states, actions, rewards, and outcomes for later training.

use_cases.title: Improve Training Workflows
use_cases.description: Use replay, batch training, and evaluation guidance to refine an existing plugin.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Plugin
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me choose an AgentDB learning plugin template for my task. Explain the recommended algorithm and first CLI steps.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Experience Storage
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design the experience fields for an AgentDB learning plugin. Include state, action, reward, next state, and completion status.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Training Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to outline a training workflow for my AgentDB plugin. Include batch size, epochs, validation, and evaluation checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Advanced Strategies
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Decision Transformer, Actor-Critic, replay, and incremental learning for my agent. Recommend a strategy with tradeoffs and risks.

output_examples.input: I need a learning plugin for discrete navigation decisions.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Q-Learning for efficient value learning, or SARSA when safer exploration is more important.

output_examples.input: I have logged expert trajectories and cannot test in the live environment.
output_examples.output: The skill points to Decision Transformer because it supports offline learning from historical sequences.

output_examples.input: Training is slow after I collect many experiences.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests batch training, replay sampling, and fewer incremental epochs before deeper optimization work.

best_practices: Start with the simplest algorithm that matches the action space and safety requirements.
Store complete experience records so training and evaluation can use consistent signals.
Evaluate learned decisions against held-out scenarios before using them in production agents.
anti_patterns: Do not choose advanced algorithms before defining rewards and success criteria.
Do not train only on successful episodes if failures are important for safety.
Do not treat confidence scores as production guarantees without separate validation.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps you plan AgentDB learning plugins that use reinforcement learning templates and training workflows.

faq.question: Does it create plugin files by itself?
faq.answer: No. It documents CLI commands and API patterns that users can run in their own environment.

faq.question: Which algorithms are covered?
faq.answer: It covers Decision Transformer, Q-Learning, SARSA, Actor-Critic, active learning, adversarial training, curriculum learning, federated learning, and multi-task learning.

faq.question: Can beginners use it?
faq.answer: Beginners can use the template guidance, but advanced training sections require machine learning background.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: The skill contains documentation links and npm command examples. Actual network use depends on commands the user chooses to run.

faq.question: Can it guarantee better agent behavior?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation guidance, but users must validate data quality, rewards, and model outcomes.
